tests.name: Relay OG was put back on the Dog
every skin was walked and photographed
Relay OG's own silhouette changes while walking, so the Dog really walked

detail.note: THE CONTROL. If the reference does not move, movement input never took and every skin below is a photograph of a standing Dog -- which is exactly how an earlier pose job passed every comparison it made.

tests.name: every skin's visible outline moves about as much as Relay OG's

detail.note: the founder's 'walk weird', asked of the thing they can actually see. A skin whose legs copy the stride perfectly but whose visible silhouette is rigid reads as GLIDING, and the two skins with floor-length body-parented drapery are the candidates.
